scope: Independent read-only audit of 16-scene road-structure classification

source_code_evidence.finding: 3m proximal query; centerline offset <=1.5m and heading <=25deg; min(distance+heading radians,id). No edge polygon containment.
Only directed outgoing_edges topology; excludes current red and repeated IDs; edge/path/successor caps; no lateral adjacency.
branch_gate_s equals accumulated centerline distance +2m at first retained multiple successor edge.
Old exported scope depends on current speed and filters endpoint direction; exported path count is not lane count or exhaustive roads.
Current HD map/localization only. ROADBLOCK/INTERSECTION/CARPARK_AREA union discards individual layer-polygon membership.
80m current-map reachability: no future frames, model, anchors, speed-direction or signal filtering; explicit not independent safety/legal certificate.

limitations: Counts of INTERSECTION objects in a 200m query do not establish current intersection occupancy.

Road union morphology supports coarse geometric classes; semantic intersection membership, legal traffic permissions and exact intersection distances require original per-object map polygons/metadata.
Several final trajectories do not establish several lanes. Several outgoing centerlines establish forward reachability only, not legal lateral lane changes.
Short, speed-filtered export can omit roads and later junctions. S13 and S14 illustrate this using independent longer current-map exports.
High confidence applies to broad visual morphology, not traffic-law certification or complete legal manoeuvre set.
Manual-style review is by the assistant; human/domain confirmation is still pending.
